message.content:
Pokémon trading cards are classified in heading 9504, which covers games, and specifically 9504.40, "Playing cards." The 9504.40.00 subheading has a 10-digit statistical suffix, 9504.40.0000. Customs rulings (for example NY N301xxx) have classified Pokémon cards in 9504.40.0000 as playing cards, though some rulings have used 9504.90.

The alternative is 9704 (stamps) or 9705 (collectors' pieces), but those do not apply here. Heading 4911 (printed matter) is also excluded because the cards are game pieces by design.

Pokémon cards are not a standard deck of playing cards. Rulings on Magic: The Gathering and Pokémon cards have typically used 9504.40.0000 ("Playing cards"). Others, such as Yu-Gi-Oh, were classified in 9504.90.9080. Recent CBP rulings on Pokémon cards (e.g., N337xxx) favor 9504.40.0000, and I will go with that.

{"hts_code": "9504.40.0000", "reason": "The Pokémon cards are designed as game pieces for the Pokémon Trading Card Game, so they are classified as playing cards in heading 9504 regardless of the importer's collector intent."}
